sonnet.problem: Card 1 names Mary Magdalene as one of the women who watched, which gives away part of the right answer to the choice on card 8 ("Mary Magdalene and the other Mary"). The baker can pick it from card 1 without reasoning. The wrong answers on card 8 can be ruled out the same way.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
